# ___Input_data___

```{r}
fetahu2023 <- readRDS(file = paste0(params$out,"Rds/fetahu2023_withMetadata.Rds"))
ALL_NK <- readRDS(file = params$input_NK)
crinier2021 <- readRDS(file = paste0(params$input_BM1))
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=6}
SCpubr::do_DimPlot(crinier2021,
                                 border.color = NA,
                                 plot_cell_borders = FALSE,
                                 reduction = "umap",
                                 colors.use =  COLOR_CODE_v2,
                                group.by = "final_clustering",
                                 repel = TRUE,
                                 font.size = 18,
                                 label.size  = 18,
                                 plot.axes = FALSE,
                                 label = FALSE,
                                 legend.title = "Clusters",
                                 plot.title = "Crinier et al., 2021",
                                 legend.position = "bottom")

```



```{r}
Idents(ALL_NK) <- ALL_NK@meta.data$sample
ALL_NK <- RenameIdents(ALL_NK, 
                    "2005_1702" = "ATRXmut_01", 
                    "2006_2684" = "sporadic_01",
                    "2014_0102" = "ctrl_01",
                    "2016_1853" = "ctrl_02",
                    "2016_2950" = "ctrl_03",
                    "2016_3924" = "ATRXmut_02",
                    "2016_4503" = "MYCNA_01",
                    "2018_1404" = "MYCNA_02",
                    "2018_1625" = "sporadic_02",
                    "2018_4252" = "ctrl_04",
                    "2018_6056" = "sporadic_03",
                    "2019_2495" = "sporadic_04",
                    "2019_5022" = "MYCNA_03",
                    "2019_5754" = "MYCNA_04",
                    "2020_1288" = "ctrl_05",
                    "2020_1667" = "sporadic_05")

ALL_NK@meta.data$patients <- Idents(ALL_NK)

ALL_NK <- 
  ALL_NK %>% 
  NormalizeData(normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
                scale.factor = 10000)

crinier2021 <- 
  crinier2021 %>% 
  NormalizeData(normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
                scale.factor = 10000)


# Crinier et al., 2021 as reference
NK_clusters <- crinier2021$final_clustering # !!!
original_clusters <- ALL_NK$orig.ident

ALL_NK_mat <- GetAssayData(ALL_NK, 
                        assay = "RNA", 
                        slot = "data")

crinier2021_mat <- GetAssayData(crinier2021, 
                            assay = "RNA", 
                            slot = "data")
```

# ___Label transfer___

```{r}
predicted_labels <- SingleR(test = ALL_NK_mat, 
                            ref = crinier2021_mat, 
                            labels = NK_clusters, 
                            de.n = 350, # parameter chosen based on sensitivity analysis (script 08_.Rmd)
                            num.threads = 80)
```

## ___QC of label transfer___

```{r QC of predicted labels: crinier2021}
predicted_label <- predicted_labels$labels
predicted_label2 <- predicted_labels$pruned.labels

pdf(paste0(params$out,"figures/lablel_transfer_QC.pdf"),
    height = 5,width = 7)
plotScoreHeatmap(predicted_labels, 
                 normalize = TRUE,
                 show.labels = TRUE,
                 annotation_col = as.data.frame(ALL_NK@meta.data[,"rados_et_al_2025.x",
                                                         drop = FALSE]))
dev.off()

plotScoreHeatmap(predicted_labels, 
                 normalize = TRUE,
                 show.labels = TRUE,
                 annotation_col = as.data.frame(ALL_NK@meta.data[,"rados_et_al_2025.x",
                                                         drop = FALSE]))

plotDeltaDistribution(predicted_labels, 
                      ncol = 2
                      )

# defult delta treshold
to.remove <- is.na(predicted_labels$pruned.labels)
table(Label=predicted_labels$labels, Removed = to.remove)
# manual delta treshold
to.remove <- pruneScores(predicted_labels, min.diff.med = 0.01)
table(Label=predicted_labels$labels, Removed = to.remove)

plotScoreHeatmap(predicted_labels[to.remove,], 
                 normalize = TRUE,
                 show.labels = TRUE,
                 annotation_col = as.data.frame(ALL_NK@meta.data[,"sample",
                                                         drop = FALSE]))

to.remove <- pruneScores(predicted_labels, min.diff.med = 0.001)
table(Label=predicted_labels$labels, Removed = to.remove)

plotScoreHeatmap(predicted_labels[to.remove,], 
                 normalize = TRUE,
                 show.labels = TRUE,
                 annotation_col = as.data.frame(ALL_NK@meta.data[,"sample",
                                                         drop = FALSE]))
```


```{r label transfer results: crinier2021}
ALL_NK$predicted_NK_type <- predicted_label


cluster_anno <- c("hNK_Bm1","hNK_Bm2","hNK_Bm3","hNK_Bm4")

DimPlot(ALL_NK,
        group.by = "predicted_NK_type",
        cols = COLOR_CODE_GROUP)

DimPlot(ALL_NK,
        group.by = "predicted_NK_type",
        split.by = "group",
        cols = COLOR_CODE_GROUP)

percent_NK_group <- table(ALL_NK$predicted_NK_type,
                          ALL_NK$group)
percent_NK_group

percent_NK_sample <- table(ALL_NK$predicted_NK_type,
                          ALL_NK$rados_et_al_2025.x)

barplot(percent_NK_group,
        col = COLOR_CODE_GROUP, 
        border = "white", 
        xlab = "Group",
        legend.text = cluster_anno)
        
# Transform this data in %
data_percentage <- apply(percent_NK_group, 2, 
                         function(x){x*100/sum(x,na.rm=T)})
 

data_percentage_sample <- apply(percent_NK_sample, 2, 
                         function(x){x*100/sum(x,na.rm=T)})

# Make a stacked barplot in %
barplot(data_percentage, 
        col = COLOR_CODE_v2, 
        border = "white", 
        xlab = "Group",
        legend.text = cluster_anno)

barplot(data_percentage_sample, 
        col = COLOR_CODE_v2, 
        border = "white", 
        xlab = "Group",
        legend.text = cluster_anno)

# with ggplot2

percent_NK_group_trans <- melt(data_percentage) 

ggplot(percent_NK_group_trans, aes(x = Var2, y = value, fill = Var1)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  theme_void() + 
  labs(x = "", y = "Percentage of NK cells assigned to each sub-cluster", 
       fill = "NK clusters") +  
  ggtitle("Clustered Stacked Bar Plot of NK Groups") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, 
                                   hjust = 1,
                                   color = "black",
                                   size = 16),
        axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0,
                                   hjust = 1,
                                   color = "black",
                                   size = 16),
        legend.text = element_text(angle = 0, 
                                   hjust = 1,
                                   color = "black",
                                   size = 18),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16,
                                    color = "black",),                        
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16,
                                    angle = 90,
                                    color = "black",),                 
        legend.title = element_text(size = 16,
                                    color = "black"),
        title = element_text(size = 20,
                                    color = "black")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = COLOR_CODE_v2)


# all samples
percent_NK_samples_trans <- melt(data_percentage_sample) 

# Step 1: Reshape the data into wide format for clustering
data_wide <- t(data_percentage_sample)

# Compute the Euclidean distance matrix
d <- dist(data_wide, method = "euclidean")

# Perform hierarchical clustering using complete linkage
hc <- hclust(d, method = "complete")

# Step 3: Reorder the samples based on clustering
ordered_samples <- rownames(data_wide)[hc$order]

# Arrange the data frame by the ordered Var2 column
percent_NK_samples_trans <- percent_NK_samples_trans %>%
  arrange(Var2)

# View the reordered data frame
print(percent_NK_samples_trans)


# Step 4: Plot the clustered bar plot
ggplot(percent_NK_samples_trans, aes(x = Var2, y = value, fill = Var1)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  theme_void() + 
  labs(x = "", y = "Percentage of NK cells assigned to each sub-cluster", 
       fill = "NK clusters") +  
  ggtitle("Clustered Stacked Bar Plot of NK Groups") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90,
                                   hjust = 1,
                                   color = "black",
                                   size = 16),
        axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0,
                                   hjust = 1,
                                   color = "black",
                                   size = 16),
        legend.text = element_text(angle = 0, 
                                   hjust = 1,
                                   color = "black",
                                   size = 18),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16,
                                    color = "black",),                        
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16,
                                    angle = 90,
                                    color = "black",),                 
        legend.title = element_text(size = 16,
                                    color = "black"),
        title = element_text(size = 20,
                                    color = "black")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = COLOR_CODE_v2)



# sort by alphabet
ordered_samples <- sort(ordered_samples)

# Step 1: Ensure Var2 is correctly converted into a factor with the desired order
percent_NK_samples_trans$Var2 <- factor(percent_NK_samples_trans$Var2, levels = ordered_samples)

# Arrange the data frame by the ordered Var2 column
percent_NK_samples_trans <- percent_NK_samples_trans %>% 
  arrange(Var2,value)


ggplot(percent_NK_samples_trans, aes(x = Var2, y = value, fill = Var1)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  theme_void() + 
  labs(x = "", y = "Percentage of NK cells assigned to each sub-cluster", 
       fill = "NK clusters") +  
  ggtitle("Stacked Bar Plot of NK Groups") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90,
                                   hjust = 1,
                                   color = "black",
                                   size = 16),
        axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0,
                                   hjust = 1,
                                   color = "black",
                                   size = 16),
        legend.text = element_text(angle = 0, 
                                   hjust = 1,
                                   color = "black",
                                   size = 18),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16,
                                    color = "black",),                        
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16,
                                    angle = 90,
                                    color = "black",),                 
        legend.title = element_text(size = 16,
                                    color = "black"),
        title = element_text(size = 20,
                                    color = "black")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = COLOR_CODE_v2)
```
